QuestInfo.name: Ultra Cannon Prepper
QuestInfo.0: #bBeldar#k needs to talk to you about one last task for the Blue Dragon Cannon.
QuestInfo.1: The last material listed on the ancient schematic is too faded to read. Use the #bD-03 Transmitter#k to get the information from the Heliseum branch for #bBeldar#k.
QuestInfo.2: You gave the Heliseum branch's information to Beldar. Now they can finish the Cannon!

0.msg: I'm sure you saw Cartalion was working from an ancient schematic.\r\n

1.msg: Up to this point, the fact that it's an old document hasn't mattered. Unfortunately, we've discovered part of it is too faint to read.\r\n

2.msg: We can't figure out what the last part we need is. We've tried all kinds of substitutes without luck.\r\n

3.msg: Honestly, I don't really know what you can do to help.\r\n

4.msg: #b(This is way beyond your area of expertise. What could they possibly need?)#k\r\n

5.msg: #b(Hm, Gen did say to call the Heliseum branch if you ran into trouble. Is this the kind of thing he meant?)#k\r\n

0.msg:
#b(They'll show up if I use the D-03 Transmitter at the Merchant Meet-Up. No time like the present.)#k
#r(You will automatically move to the relevant field.)#k
#rIf you lose the D-03 Transmitter, you can get another via the quest in the light bulb notifier.#k
#b(Beldar is pretty worked up over this last part.)#k\r\n
Really? There's a ton of that material around here. I'll go right now and check it out.\r\n

1.msg: #b(Beldar is talking animatedly with Cartalion, and it seems like he's got good news.)#k\r\n

2.msg: This is it! This is the last piece we needed to finish the Blue Dragon Cannon. How did you figure it out?\r\n

3.msg: Oh, it's a long story. I'm just glad it worked.\r\n

default.0: #b(Hm, Gen did say to call the Heliseum branch if you ran into trouble. Guess it's time to give the ol' boss a call.)#k\r\n#rIf you lose the D-03 Transmitter, you can get another via the quest in the light bulb notifier.#k\r\n
